fields.name: slot_age_table
fields.meaning: Shared console-memory bookkeeping: one age byte per game-data slot 1-7 (0 = most recently written, 6 = oldest). Written by the console-memory routine in the game ROM every save; this game always marks slots 3-7, giving 06 06 04 03 02 01 00
fields.evidence: diff blank->saved (00..->06 06 04 03 02 01 00); code f000:0772 (age update), f000:06b9 (called for slots 3..7); recomputed by hand

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Read together with the age table but never used; stays 0
fields.evidence: code f000:0772 reads 4 words, uses 7 bytes

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not written by this game
fields.evidence: diff: 00 in all states

fields.name: slots_1_2
fields.meaning: Game-data slots 1 and 2 of the shared area; not used by this game (left for other games)
fields.evidence: code: save/load only touch slots 3-7 (f000:0628/054e); diff: 00 in all states

fields.name: slot3_owner
fields.meaning: Owner tag of slot 3: the game id 0x0101 (also at 0x30, 0x3c, 0x48, 0x54 for slots 4-7). At power-on the game checks all five tags to decide whether a save exists; when saving over an existing save it asks before overwriting
fields.evidence: code f000:08a3 writes the caller id first word of each slot; caller id 0x0101 at f000:4876 and c000:d26a; tag check f000:071b called from c000:d1b8; diff blank->saved

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Text "WSDB" marking a valid save header
fields.evidence: code f000:063c (write), f000:0592 (load compare); diff

fields.name: password_chars_40_43
fields.meaning: Password characters 40-43 (see the password rows below); char 42-43 hold the password check
fields.evidence: code f000:064c copies buffer bytes 0x28-0x2b into the header; diff across three saves

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of the 40 password bytes in slots 4-7 plus the 8 header bytes "WSDB"+chars 40-43, 16 bits. Bad sum or missing "WSDB" = no save
fields.evidence: code f000:0628/06da (write), f000:054e (load compare); recomputed OK on all 32 valid save images (3 distinct: 01e1/01b3/01ee)

fields.name: slot4_owner
fields.meaning: Owner tag 0x0101 (see 0x24)
fields.evidence: code f000:08a3; diff

fields.name: password_chars_0_9
fields.meaning: Password characters 0-9
fields.evidence: code f000:068e (slot 4 <- buffer +0); diff

fields.name: slot5_owner
fields.meaning: Owner tag 0x0101
fields.evidence: code f000:08a3; diff

fields.name: password_chars_10_19
fields.meaning: Password characters 10-19
fields.evidence: code f000:0697; diff

fields.name: slot6_owner
fields.meaning: Owner tag 0x0101
fields.evidence: code f000:08a3; diff

fields.name: password_chars_20_29
fields.meaning: Password characters 20-29
fields.evidence: code f000:06a0; diff

fields.name: slot7_owner
fields.meaning: Owner tag 0x0101
fields.evidence: code f000:08a3; diff

fields.name: password_chars_30_39
fields.meaning: Password characters 30-39
fields.evidence: code f000:06a9; diff

fields.name: console_owner_profile
fields.meaning: Console owner profile (name, birthday etc.) kept by the console itself; not written by the game
fields.evidence: diff: identical with and without a save

fields.name: level
fields.meaning: Goku's level minus 1 (0 = level 1). Max HP and max W are looked up from the level after loading. Bits: char 0 (0x32) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 0 (0x32) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 1 (0x33) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: status screen (level 1) vs value 0; code f000:c6b5 (level table); saver d000:350c <- RAM 08e1

fields.name: speed
fields.meaning: Speed (スピード). Bits: char 1 (0x33) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 2 (0x34) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 3 (0x35) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: status draw d000:0130 prints this byte on stat row 1 (value 3 on screen); saver d000:3514 <- RAM 08e2

fields.name: power
fields.meaning: Power (パワー). Bits: char 2 (0x34) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 4 (0x36) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 5 (0x37) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: status draw d000:0152 prints this byte on stat row 2 (value 3); saver <- RAM 08e3

fields.name: technique
fields.meaning: Technique (テクニック). Bits: char 3 (0x35) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 6 (0x38) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 7 (0x39) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: status screen: the only stat with value 1 = this byte, drawn on row 3 (d000:0174); saver <- RAM 08e4

fields.name: toughness
fields.meaning: Toughness (タフネス). Bits: char 4 (0x36) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 8 (0x3a) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 9 (0x3b) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: status draw d000:0196 prints this byte on stat row 4 (value 3); saver <- RAM 08e5

fields.name: hp
fields.meaning: Current HP (16 in the verified save). Bits: char 5 (0x37) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 10 (0x3e) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 11 (0x3f) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: HUD 016/016 vs 0x10; saver <- RAM 08e6; special password presets set it with max HP (f000:c9a6)

fields.name: w
fields.meaning: Current W points (10 in the verified save); special moves cost W. Bits: char 6 (0x38) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 12 (0x40) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 13 (0x41) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: HUD W010 vs 0x0a; saver <- RAM 08e7

fields.name: training
fields.meaning: Training points (修行) total, 24-bit, chars 7-9 low nibbles + high bits (see bit layout of level). Capped at 999999; the level-up thresholds come from a table in the ROM
fields.evidence: status screen shows 9 = value 9; RAM matches in two play sessions (9 early, 12 after more battles on another path); code f000:2778 (add, cap 0x0f423f), f000:27f5 (level threshold table f000:28e1); saver <- RAM 08e8-08ea

fields.name: item_counts
fields.meaning: Counts of three kinds of item cards packed in one byte: high nibble (max 9), bits 2-3 (max 3), bits 0-1 (max 3). Bits: char 10 (0x3e) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 20 (0x4a) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 21 (0x4b) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: code c000:cbce/cc1a/cc52 (add one, with max checks), d000:2d8e (item list build); 0 in all natural saves; loader caps the high nibble at 9 (f000:c5e0); saver <- RAM 08eb

fields.name: flags_08ed
fields.meaning: Bits 0-1: count of a fourth item card (0-3). Bits 2-7: event/progress flags. Bits: char 11 (0x3f) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 22 (0x4c) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 23 (0x4d) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: code: saver d000:34fb puts the item count (RAM 105b) in bits 0-1; c000:cc85 (count +1, max 3); c000:ba32-baf1 (flag bits); 0 in all natural saves

fields.name: flags_08ee
fields.meaning: Event/progress flags. Bits: char 12 (0x40) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 24 (0x4e) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 25 (0x4f) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: code: copied to/from RAM 08ee; special password 2 sets 0x6b; 0 in all natural saves

fields.name: flags_08ef
fields.meaning: Event/progress flags. Bits: char 13 (0x41) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 26 (0x50) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: code: RAM 08ef; special password 2 sets 0xda; 0 in natural saves

fields.name: flags_08f0
fields.meaning: Event/progress flags. Bits: char 14 (0x42) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 27 (0x51) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: code: RAM 08f0; 0 in natural saves and in all presets

fields.name: special_and_dir
fields.meaning: Bits 6-7: which special password was used (1-3, 0 = none; after special password 3, maximum stats, no more training points are gained). Bits 4-5: a 0-3 value that the game rotates with the buttons (probably a facing/view setting). Bits 0-3 always 0. Bits: char 15 (0x43) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 28 (0x52) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: code d000:34d9-34f6 (saver builds it from RAM 108a and 105c), f000:c707-c727 (loader restores them); f000:c8ea (special password sets 108a); c000:1a18/1c52 (105c +-1 mod 4)

fields.name: flags_08f2
fields.meaning: Event/progress flags (0x88 in the verified save). Bits: char 16 (0x44) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 29 (0x53) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: diff: 0x88 in all three natural saves; code d000:406c tests bit 4; saver <- RAM 08f2

fields.name: flags_08f3
fields.meaning: Event/progress flags (0x13 in the verified save). Bits: char 17 (0x45) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 30 (0x56) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: diff: 0x13 in all three natural saves; special password 2 sets 0x80; code c000:cd13 tests bit 7; saver <- RAM 08f3

fields.name: state_08ec
fields.meaning: Story state value (compared with 0, 2, 12 by the map code). Bits: char 18 (0x46) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 31 (0x57) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: code c000:606b/607b/6821; 0 in natural saves; saver d000:359c <- RAM 08ec

fields.name: state_08f5
fields.meaning: Story/event state (0 in all natural saves). Bits: char 19 (0x47) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 32 (0x58) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: code: saver <- RAM 08f5; c000:68ae etc. read 08f5; 0 in natural saves

fields.name: state_08f6
fields.meaning: Story/event state (0 in all natural saves). Bits: char 20 (0x4a) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 33 (0x59) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: code: saver <- RAM 08f6; c000:68ae etc. read 08f5; 0 in natural saves

fields.name: state_08f7
fields.meaning: Story/event state (0 in all natural saves). Bits: char 21 (0x4b) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 34 (0x5a) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: code: saver <- RAM 08f7; c000:68ae etc. read 08f5; 0 in natural saves

fields.name: state_08f8
fields.meaning: Story/event state (0 in all natural saves). Bits: char 22 (0x4c) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 35 (0x5b) bits0-3 -> bits4-7
fields.evidence: code: saver <- RAM 08f8; c000:68ae etc. read 08f5; 0 in natural saves

fields.name: square_kind
fields.meaning: Kind of square Goku stands on; 0xf0/0xf1 = inside a town or place (then the position is saved as a place number). 1 on the start square, 4 two squares further on. Bits: char 23 (0x4d) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 26 (0x50) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 27 (0x51) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: diff across three saves at three map positions (1 -> 4 -> 1); RAM matches in each; code c000:3f8e and many map routines compare with 0xf0/0xf1; saver d000:35c4

fields.name: area_0x8ff
fields.meaning: Area or chapter number (compared with 9 and 21 by the map code); 0 in all natural saves. Bits: char 24 (0x4e) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 28 (0x52) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 29 (0x53) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: code c000:54dc/5817 (about 160 reads); saver d000:35cc <- RAM 08ff

fields.name: special_moves_1
fields.meaning: Special moves learned (bit flags); the loader also ORs level bits (level 10: 0x40, level 11: 0x48, level 12+: 0x4c). Bits: char 25 (0x4f) bits0-3 -> bits0-3; char 30 (0x56) bits4-5 -> bits6-7; char 31 (0x57) bits4-5 -> bits4-5
fields.evidence: code e000:dd8c-ddf3 (special-move list), d000:9736 (sets bit 1), f000:c6d8-c707 (loader sets bits for level 10/11+); saver <- RAM 0902

fields.name: special_moves_2
fields.meaning: Special moves learned, second byte (bit flags). Bit 3 is in char 32 bit 5 (0x58), bits 4-7 in char 42 bits 2-5 (0x2c); bits 0-2 are not saved
fields.evidence: code e000:dd0f-dd4a (move list), d000:9029-9055 (sets bits 6/7); saver d000:3754 and 37df; loader f000:c44e/c45c

fields.name: pos_a
fields.meaning: Map position, first rotated coordinate: (x + y - 64) / 2, where x and y are the map square coordinates. 0 when Goku is inside a place
fields.evidence: diff across three saves (0x1f/0x1f/0x20) against RAM 08fd/08fe (45/39, 43/3b, 3f/41); code d000:35f8 (saver), f000:c6a2 (loader: y = a + b, x = a - b + 64)

fields.name: pos_b
fields.meaning: Map position, second rotated coordinate: (y - x + 64) / 2; when Goku is inside a place, the place number instead
fields.evidence: diff across three saves (0x1a -> 0x1c -> 0x21); code d000:361f (saver), d000:3619 (place number from RAM 0ce9), f000:c682 (loader place table)

fields.name: flags_08f4
fields.meaning: Event flags (RAM 08f4): bit 3 in char 32 bit 4, bits 1-2 in char 33 bits 4-5, bits 6-7 in char 34 bits 4-5, bits 4-5 in char 35 bits 4-5; bit 0 is not saved
fields.evidence: code d000:3761-37b8 (saver), f000:c4ab (loader); c000:5591 tests bit 1, c000:cce5 sets bit 2; 0 in natural saves

fields.name: flags_08f9_08fb
fields.meaning: Three more flag bytes (RAM 08f9, 08fa, 08fb) spread 2 bits at a time over chars 38-41: char 38+k bits 0-1 = 08f9 bits 2k..2k+1, bits 2-3 = 08fa, bits 4-5 = 08fb
fields.evidence: code d000:3661-36fb (saver), f000:c4d0-c5a6 (loader); 0 in natural saves

fields.name: password_check
fields.meaning: Password check: 8-bit hash of chars 0-41 (each step: h = table[h] + char, running byte sum), top 2 bits in char 42 bits 0-1, low 6 bits in char 43. Checked when the password is typed in; not checked when loading from console memory (the memory checksum covers that)
fields.evidence: recomputed OK on all three distinct saves (hashes b4/c0/f8); code d000:382e (hash, table at ROM 0x1ca773), d000:37df-3800
